scope: Browser catalog/application/production worker and existing UI. Version-history controls are not yet integrated or published. No hardware/radio or all-OS validation.

recheck.scope: Retest only the affected scoped-status scenario and add the compiled production worker site scenario in each engine. The other 64 scenarios per engine retain their unchanged full-regression results.
